WITH period_end AS (
  SELECT period_end_date AS as_of_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period = 8
), as_of_version AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.tier FROM dim_member m, period_end p
  WHERE m.join_date <= p.as_of_date AND m.valid_from <= p.as_of_date AND m.valid_to >= p.as_of_date
), purchasers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key, period_end p

)
SELECT v.tier, count(*) AS active_members
